title: The member opens the catalog
description: The member opens the [Catalog](../../views/V01-catalog.md), which lists every tool with its status (`GET /tools`).

title: The member borrows an available tool, or is told why not
description: The member picks an available tool and borrows it (`POST /loans`). If the tool is not available, or the member cannot borrow, the catalog shows the reason.

title: The catalog shows the loan with its due date
description: The catalog shows the new loan and the date the tool is due back.

title: The librarian records the return and its condition
description: When the member brings the tool back, the librarian opens the [Return desk](../../views/V02-return-desk.md) and records its condition (`POST /loans/{loanId}/return`). A return without a condition is refused.

title: The return desk shows whether the return was late
description: The return desk shows the returned loan and whether it came back after its due date.

title: The catalog shows the tool as available, or as needing repair
description: A tool returned in good condition is available again; one returned needing repair is out of lending until it is mended.

title: A librarian marks a damaged tool as needing repair, with a note
description: A librarian finds a damaged tool and, at the [Return desk](../../views/V02-return-desk.md), marks it as needing repair with a note (`POST /tools/{toolId}/damage`). If it is on loan, the loan carries on.

title: The catalog shows the tool needing repair, and borrowing it is refused
description: The [Catalog](../../views/V01-catalog.md) shows the tool as needing repair (or on loan), and a borrow of it is refused.

title: Once fixed, the librarian marks it repaired and it is available again
description: Once the tool is fixed, the librarian marks it repaired (`POST /tools/{toolId}/repair`) and the catalog shows it as available.
